t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Focus on the high scoring gnomes. For unknown gnomes it's best to go wit x1 multiplier. There isn't any pattern for points other than colour.

vb_textbox.text: I had luck with focusing on the type of gnome...after a streak it would change up. For the 1x multiplier i would pick an unknown gnome as those were lower value. for the 5x I would go with my safe bet gnomes/ pattern to get higher points.
